🔎 Reality check (real reports)
• Delhi’s January–September 2026 average AQI was about 167.6, up from 164.3 over the same months of 2025 (CPCB bulletins, analysis reported by UNI).
• aqi.in reports Delhi’s January 2026 PM2.5 averaged about 212 µg/m³, roughly 14.5% above its 2020–25 January baseline.
• CREA named Ghaziabad India’s most polluted city in January 2026 (about 184 µg/m³ PM2.5).
I could not find an official all-India monthly series for 2026, so the graph above uses this game’s simulated feed.
